posts.author: MintyKaru
posts.body:
WORLDS DETECTIVE CLUBS is an RPG Maker VX ACE game by MINTY KARU.
(Inspired by the 2014 version of OMORI and Yokai watch)
Play between 2 worlds with 2 protagonists set on a goal of discovering the truth to many bizarre events that have been taking place in both worlds!
「BOKU」After reuniting with his old best friend BOKU with his old best friend BUN BUN they must discover the truth many strange events that have been taking place in their world forming the RAIN RAIN DETECTIVE CLUB, they must travel across their strange and surreal world to discover the many hints that lead to the truth.
「RAYMOND」After struggling with financial issues for a year RAYMOND and his family move back to their old home town BELL'S MORE TOWN reconnecting with old friends, after talking about rumors about their town RAYMOND and his old friend MARY investigate an old abandoned office and discover a door leading into a bridge between both worlds sending both RAYMOND and BOKU to this strange place RAYMOND and friends decide to investigate what is going on in their town and open up the RAY RAY DETECTIVE CLUB.
Both detective clubs must discover the truth to all the strange events happening in both worlds causing both worlds to connect.
In the end only one world can keep on existing but that's for you decide which one not me.
